message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.62,"fairness_assessment":"A structured preference vote is fair because all three budget strategies receive equal consideration, while allowing stakeholders to rank trade-offs rather than rewarding only the strongest advocate.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"agent_1","position":"Favors a full-budget inter-city tournament with buffet and prizes to maximize visibility and immediate club impact.","influence":0.32},{"agent":"agent_2","position":"Favors investing the entire budget in educational resources and new chessboards for durable club development.","influence":0.4},{"agent":"agent_3","position":"Favors an equal hybrid allocation between a smaller tournament and equipment purchases.","influence":0.28}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"The dispute concerns legitimate short-term visibility versus long-term capacity building, and no option is decisively superior. Use a ranked-choice or score-based social-choice vote, preceded by shared cost and impact estimates; if no option obtains broad support, adopt a revised hybrid budget with evidence-based proportions rather than an arbitrary 50/50 split."}
